name: claudesay
description: An ASCII mascot above the prompt: it holds a prop while a tool runs and says the point of each reply

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: on: Claude ends each conversational reply with a short <claudesay> tag, and the mascot says it above the prompt; it also holds a prop while a tool runs. tools: props only, no protocol in the system prompt. off: no mascot.
